next_step: Finalize PoC acceptance criteria + schedule on-prem installer window; SE to run airgapped deployment exercise; confirm HSM model key flow
notes:

- Need: air-gapped Private deployment (no outbound internet) for AI-powered incident summarization, prioritized outages triage, and operator chat assistant.

- Ops notes: customer needs offline metrics export (logs to local ELK), and a way to revoke model binaries in case of security findings.
- Decision factors: HSM integration, install automation, incident response SLA, price vs. dedicated capacity alternatives.
